description_en: Updates the analysis template of a smart tag job
description_zh: 更新一个智能标签作业的分析模板
name: UpdateSmarttagTemplate

parameters.help_en: The template ID. You can obtain the ID from the response parameters of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187759.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 模板ID。可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187759.html的返回参数中获取
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The custom template name. The name can contain Chinese and English characters and must be up to 120 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 自定义模板名称，字符串内容中英文不限，最长120字符
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.help_en:
The industry of the file to be analyzed. Default value: common (general industry). Select an appropriate industry so that the system can match the algorithm combination applicable to the industry in the background. Valid values: 

microVideo: short video industry.
common: general industry
parameters.help_zh:
待分析文件所处行业。默认值：common（通用行业）。请选择合适的行业，用于后台匹配适用于行业的算法组合。取值： 

microVideo：小视频行业。
common：通用行业
parameters.name: industry

parameters.help_en:
The scenario. Select an appropriate scenario so that the system can match the applicable algorithm combination in the background. Valid values:

search: search scenario.
recommend: recommendation scenario.

Default value: search
parameters.help_zh:
使用场景，选择合适的使用场景，用于后台匹配适用的算法组合。取值：

search：搜索场景。
recommend：推荐场景。

默认search
parameters.name: scene

parameters.help_en:
The analysis types. You can specify multiple types and separate them with commas (,). Valid values:

ocr: recognizes labels from text in images.
asr: recognizes labels from audio speech.
classification: video categorization.
shows: recognizes TV shows in videos.
face: recognizes faces in videos.
role: recognizes character roles in videos.
object: recognizes objects in videos.
tvstation: recognizes TV station logos in videos.
action: recognizes actions and events in videos.
emotion: recognizes facial expressions in videos.
landmark: recognizes landmarks in videos.
scene: recognizes scenarios in videos.

movielp: recognizes movie IPs in videos.

subtitle: the caption fetch feature
parameters.help_zh:
分析类型，可多选，⽤半角逗号（,）分隔。当前有以下类型：

ocr：从图像⽂字中识别出标签。
asr：从⾳频语⾳中识别出标签。
classification：视频分类。
shows：视频识别节⽬。
face：视频识别⼈脸。
role：视频识别⼈物⻆⾊。
object：视频识别物体。
tvstation：视频识别台标。
action：视频识别动作事件。
emotion：视频识别表情。
landmark：视频识别地标。
scene：视频识别场景。

movielp：视频识别影视IP。

subtitle：字幕提取功能
parameters.name: analyse_types

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the face libraries used for recognition. You can specify multiple IDs and separate them with commas (,). You can specify system face library IDs and custom face library IDs. The system face library IDs are as follows:

celebrity: celebrities.
politician: politicians.
sensitive: sensitive figures.

Default value: celebrity, politician, and sensitive.

For more information about custom face library IDs, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187777.html
parameters.help_zh:
参与识别的⼈脸库ID列表，可多选，⽤逗号隔开。可填⼊系统⼈脸库ID和⾃定义⼈脸库ID。其中系统⼈脸库ID如下：

celebrity：明星⼈物。
politician：政治⼈物。
sensitive：敏感⼈物。

参数默认值：celebrity，politician，sensitive。

⾃定义⼈物库ID详⻅https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187777.html
parameters.name: face_category_ids

parameters.help_en:
The parameters for the face algorithm in JSON string format. Currently, the face detection threshold and face recognition threshold are supported.

faceDetThreshold: the face detection threshold. Default value: 0.999. This parameter takes effect only for unknown face analysis.

faceRegThreshold: the face recognition threshold. Default value: 0.9
parameters.help_zh:
人脸算法的参数，JSON String形式，目前支持人脸检测阈值和人脸识别阈值。

faceDetThreshold：人脸检测阈值，默认阈值0.999，只对陌生人脸分析有效。

faceRegThreshold：人脸识别阈值，默认阈值0.9
parameters.name: face_custom_params_config

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the object libraries used for recognition. You can specify multiple IDs and separate them with commas (,). You can specify system object library IDs and custom object library IDs. The system object library IDs are as follows:

general: general.

item: commodities.

weapon: weapons.

animal: animals.

For more information about custom object library IDs, see the description of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/451180.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
参与识别的物体库ID列表，可多选，⽤半角逗号（,）分隔。可填⼊系统物体库ID和⾃定义物体库ID。其中系统物体库ID如下：

general：通用。

item：商品。

weapon：武器。

animal：动物。

⾃定义物体库ID请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/451180.html接口说明
parameters.name: object_group_ids

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the landmark libraries used for recognition. You can specify multiple IDs and separate them with commas (,). You can specify system landmark library IDs and custom landmark library IDs. The system landmark library IDs are as follows:

common: general.

For more information about custom landmark library IDs, see the description of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/451182.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
参与识别的地域库ID列表，可多选，⽤半角逗号（,）分隔。可填⼊系统地域库ID和⾃定义地域库ID。其中系统地域库ID如下：

common：通用。

⾃定义地域库ID请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/451182.html接口说明
parameters.name: landmark_group_ids

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the template is the default template. Valid values:

true: yes.
false: no.

Default value: false. A user can have only one default template
parameters.help_zh:
是否默认模板，取值：

true：是。
false：否。

默认false，⼀个⽤户只能有⼀个默认模板
parameters.name: is_default

parameters.help_en:
The tagging type. Default value: auto. Valid values:

auto: machine tagging.

hmi: human-machine collaboration
parameters.help_zh:
标注类型，默认auto。目前支持类型：

auto：机器打标。

hmi：人机协同
parameters.name: label_type

parameters.help_en:
The smart tag version. Default value: 1.0. Valid values:

1.0: Smart Tag 1.0.

2.0: Smart Tag 2.0 (CPV tags).

2.0-custom: Smart Tag 2.0-custom (custom model for CPV tags)
parameters.help_zh:
指定智能标签版本，默认为"1.0"。

1.0：智能标签1.0，

2.0：智能标签2.0（CPV标签）

2.0-custom：智能标签2.0-custom（CPV标签定制模型）
parameters.name: label_version

parameters.help_en:
The field scope of the knowledge graph information recognized in the returned tag results in Smart Tag 2.0 and 2.0-custom modes. For more information about the knowledge graph, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356383.html. If this parameter is not specified, is empty, or is invalid (not a JSON string), the following fields are returned by default:

movie:

    - name: IP name

    - alias: IP alias
    - chnl: category
    - genre: genre
    - country: producing country or region
    - language: language
    - releaseYear: release year

music:

    - songName: song name
    - artistName: artist name
    - artistArea: artist region, such as Chinese, Japanese, Korean, European and American, or other
    - albumName: album name

person:

    - name: name
    - gender: gender
    - citizenship: nationality
    - occupation: occupation
    - classification: category
    - nationality: ethnicity
    - birthPlace: birthplace
    - birthDate: date of birth

landmark:
    - name: name
    - nameEn: English name
    - description: description
    - address: address

item:

    - brandName: brand
    - finegrainName: fine-grained description
parameters.help_zh:
智能标签2.0和2.0-custom模式下，设置返回标签结果中识别到知识图谱信息字段范围。更多知识图谱信息请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356383.html。不填写或者knowledgeConfig为空或者knowledgeConfig非法（不为JSON String）时，默认输出以下字段：

movie：

    - name：IP名称

    - alias：IP别名
    - chnl：类别
    - genre：类型
    - country：制片国家、地区
    - language：语言
    -  releaseYear：发布年份

music：

    - songName：歌曲名称
    - artistName：歌手姓名
    - artistArea：歌手所属地区，华语/日本/韩国/欧美/其他
    - albumName：专辑名称

person：

    - name：姓名
    - gender：性别
    - citizenship：国籍
    -  occupation：职业
    - classification：类型
    - nationality：民族
    - birthPlace：出生地
    - birthDate：出生日期

landmark
    - name：名称
    - nameEn：英文名
    - description：描述
    - address：地址

item

    - brandName：品牌
    - finegrainName：细粒度描述
parameters.name: knowledge_config

parameters.help_en:
The keyword tag configuration. The type parameter specifies the part-of-speech categories. You can specify multiple categories and separate them with commas (,). Valid values:

name: person name

location: location name

organization: organization name

other: other

If KeywordConfig is not passed, the Keyword field is invalid (not a JSON string), KeywordsConfig does not contain the type field, or the type field is invalid, keywords of all types are returned by default
parameters.help_zh:
关键词标签配置。type代表词性类别选择，可多选，用半角逗号（,）分隔，当前有以下类别：

name：人名

location：地名

organization：机构名

other：其他

当不传KeywordConfig时或者Keyword字段非法（不为JSON String）或者KeywordsConfig不包含type字段或者type字段非法时默认返回type全部类型关键词
parameters.name: keyword_config

parameters.help_en: The smart tag template configuration in JSON character string format. Configuration items include the industry, scenarios, and analysis types. The passed configuration items overwrite the corresponding original configurations in the template
parameters.help_zh: 智能标签模板配置，使用 JSON 字符串传入。配置项包括行业、使用场景和分析类型等。传入的配置项会覆盖模板中对应的原有配置
parameters.name: template_config
